text:
maria: Noticing correlated short latency bursts in eu2 starting 06:18 UTC. Multiple tenants saw p95 spikes and we got a rack thermal alert for rack r17. Suspect warm-pool eviction churn causing noisy-neighbor effects.

infra-bot: alert: rack=r17 thermal=78C, p95_token_latency_up=28% (06:18:12 -> 06:19:02)

ashok: I pulled kv cache metrics. Tenant t-9f2 had sustained heavy prefetch + frequent evictions, evict rate ~260/min for a 2m window. Looks like the warm-pool got dominated and led to cold misses for co-tenants.

zach: We saw similar self-inflicted storms before when the eviction aggressiveness was tweaked. Any recent rollouts?

maria: Small cache GC tune was rolled last night (eu2) to reduce mem tailbloat; default eviction got slightly more aggressive. Might have lowered the threshold that keeps KV items sticky.

tess: SLA impact? How many requests breached 250ms p95 during the incident window?

azch: (fix) zach: Quick probe: ~120 requests over threshold in rack r17 minute, mostly generation/chat. No pager but definite customer-visible blips.

ryan: Costs if we isolate tenant to fractional dedicated? Rough hourly GPU overhead?

ashok: Rough estimate: moving t-9f2 to a fractional-dedicated slice for 30m -> ~0.35 GPU-hours extra. Cheaper than letting multiple tenants degrade.

maria: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) route t-9f2 to a small fractional dedicated slice 2) reduce prefetch_weight for shared pools 3) temporarily relax eviction aggressiveness in eu2 shared pools until rules are improved.

ashok: I can flip the route: `routerctl route set --tenant t-9f2 --target fractional-dedicated --slice s-502 --grace 20s`

zach: Also patch scheduler: `schedulerctl set --pool shared --prefetch-penalty 0.45` to throttle aggressive prefetchers.

tess: Please schedule infra-bot to post a delta after 20m to verify p95 improvement.

infra-bot: scheduled_check: will report metrics delta at +20m for rack=r17 and tenant=t-9f2

maria: Applied route change at 06:22:44 UTC.

infra-bot: action: route_change applied (tenant=t-9f2 -> fractional-dedicated slice s-502), timestamp=3922223370

ryan: Agree with isolation. Long-term we should consider auto-quarantine when eviction loops coincide with thermal events.

ashok: Adding a short detector rule draft:
```
rule: kv-eviction-loop-quarantine
if kv_evictions_per_min > 200 and thermal_alert_recent(5m)
then actions: notify #eng-infra, assign-fractional, throttle-prefetch
```

zach: +1. Also we should capture tenant-specific heatmap mapping so ops can quickly see which tenants map to which racks during incidents.

tess: Filing follow-ups: (1) persist detector rule and tune thresholds (2) add thermal+eviction correlation panel in dashboards (3) add a cost-approved play for fractional isolates when non-pager SLOs at risk.

maria: I'll open the ticket and include cost delta estimate. For now infra-bot will confirm. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
